category5.design: No harness reaches createTreeFromFile, so a driver adapted from the failing gtest loads the PoV file with it; match on the file-not-found error the injected path prefix causes. The driver first validates the text with createTreeFromText, so an empty or broken file (which also fails on the secure build, with another message) prints only invalid-tree and cannot pass.
